global_summary: This video documents a coordinated flash mob protest held in Sydney, Australia on May 19, 2012, under the banner "#SILENCEISBETRAYAL" to raise awareness about the Syrian crisis. The event features participants performing synchronized, solemn gestures including kneeling, bowing heads, and dramatic pointing motions, while holding signs with messages like "OPEN YOUR EYES," "BASHAR YOU TYRANT," and "HOW MANY MORE CHILDREN?" The protest combines elements of performance art with political activism, using silence and choreographed movement to create a powerful visual statement against global inaction on Syria.
